11.1.en: Arjuna: "You've shared the deepest secret with me, and my confusion is gone."
11.1.hi: Arjun: "Aapne mujhe sabse gehra raaz bataya, aur mera confusion chala gaya."

11.2.en: "I've heard how everything begins and ends in you, and how great you are."
11.2.hi: "Maine suna ki sab kuch aap mein shuru aur khatam hota hai, aur aap kitne mahaan ho."

11.3.en: "I believe you. But now I want to actually see your divine form."
11.3.hi: "Mujhe aap pe bharosa hai. Par ab main aapka divya roop sach mein dekhna chahta hoon."

11.4.en: "If you think I can handle it, please show me." Brave request.
11.4.hi: "Agar aapko lagta hai main handle kar sakta hoon, toh please dikhao." Bahaduri wali request.

11.5.en: Krishna: "Then look. Hundreds and thousands of my forms, in every colour and shape."
11.5.hi: Krishna: "Toh dekho. Mere sainkdon-hazaaron roop, har rang aur shape mein."

11.6.en: "See all the gods and wonders no one has ever seen before."
11.6.hi: "Saare devta aur woh ajoobe dekho jo kisi ne pehle nahi dekhe."

11.7.en: "The whole universe, everything moving and still, is right here in my body. Look."
11.7.hi: "Poora brahmaand, har chalti aur ruki cheez, yahin mere shareer mein hai. Dekho."

11.8.en: "Your normal eyes can't handle this. Here, I'm giving you divine vision." Upgrade unlocked.
11.8.hi: "Tumhari normal aankhein ye nahi dekh sakti. Lo, main tumhe divya drishti deta hoon." Upgrade unlocked.

11.9.en: And then Krishna reveals his supreme cosmic form. The biggest reveal in the Gita.
11.9.hi: Aur phir Krishna apna param vishwaroop dikhate hain. Gita ka sabse bada reveal.

11.10.en: Countless faces and eyes, endless wonders, divine jewellery and weapons everywhere.
11.10.hi: Anginat chehre aur aankhein, anant ajoobe, har taraf divya gehne aur hathiyar.

11.11.en: Divine garlands and robes, heavenly fragrance, glowing, infinite, facing every direction at once.
11.11.hi: Divya maalaayein aur vastra, swargiya khushboo, chamakta hua, anant, ek saath har disha mein.

11.12.en: Imagine a thousand suns rising at once. That's how bright this form was.
11.12.hi: Socho ek saath hazaar suraj ug jaayein. Itna tez tha ye roop.

11.13.en: Arjuna saw the entire universe, in all its variety, in one place: inside Krishna.
11.13.hi: Arjun ne poora brahmaand, apni har variety ke saath, ek jagah dekha: Krishna ke andar.

11.14.en: Arjuna is stunned, goosebumps everywhere. He bows his head and folds his hands.
11.14.hi: Arjun hairaan hai, rongte khade. Sar jhukata hai aur haath jodta hai.

11.15.en: "I see all the gods, all beings, Brahma, the sages and the divine serpents in you."
11.15.hi: "Mujhe aap mein saare devta, saare jeev, Brahma, rishi aur divya naag dikh rahe hain."

11.16.en: "Endless arms, faces and eyes everywhere. I can't find your beginning, middle or end."
11.16.hi: "Har taraf anginat haath, chehre aur aankhein. Aapka shuru, beech ya ant nahi dikhta."

11.17.en: "You're a mass of blazing light, like fire and the sun. Hard to even look at."
11.17.hi: "Aap jalti roshni ka dher ho, aag aur suraj jaise. Dekhna bhi mushkil hai."

11.18.en: "You're the eternal, the highest truth, the support of everything, the protector of what's right."
11.18.hi: "Aap amar ho, param satya, sabka aadhaar, dharm ke rakshak."

11.19.en: "No beginning, no end, infinite power. Sun and moon are your eyes. Your fire heats the universe."
11.19.hi: "Na shuru, na ant, anant shakti. Suraj aur chaand aapki aankhein. Aapki aag brahmaand ko tapati hai."

11.20.en: "You fill the space between earth and sky. All three worlds are shaking at this sight."
11.20.hi: "Aap dharti aur aakash ke beech sab bhar dete ho. Teenon lok ye dekh ke kaanp rahe hain."

11.21.en: "Gods are entering you. Some, afraid, pray with folded hands. Sages sing your praises."
11.21.hi: "Devta aap mein samaa rahe hain. Kuch darr ke haath jod rahe hain. Rishi aapke gun gaa rahe hain."

11.22.en: "Every kind of divine being is staring at you in total amazement."
11.22.hi: "Har tarah ke divya jeev aapko poori hairaani se dekh rahe hain."

11.23.en: "So many mouths, eyes, arms and terrifying teeth. The worlds are trembling, and so am I."
11.23.hi: "Itne munh, aankhein, haath aur darawne daant. Duniya kaanp rahi hai, aur main bhi."

11.24.en: "You're touching the sky, blazing in every colour. I'm shaking inside and can't find calm."
11.24.hi: "Aap aasmaan chhoo rahe ho, har rang mein chamak rahe ho. Main andar se kaanp raha hoon, shaanti nahi mil rahi."

11.25.en: "Your mouths look like the fire at the end of time. I'm lost. Please, have mercy."
11.25.hi: "Aapke munh pralay ki aag jaise lagte hain. Main kho gaya hoon. Please, daya karo."

11.26.en: "I see Duryodhana's brothers, Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and our warriors too..."
11.26.hi: "Mujhe Duryodhan ke bhai, Bheeshma, Drona, Karna, aur hamare yoddha bhi dikh rahe hain..."

11.27.en: "...rushing into your terrifying mouths and being crushed." Arjuna sees the outcome before the battle.
11.27.hi: "...aapke darawne munh mein ghuste aur pis-te hue." Arjun ladai se pehle hi result dekh leta hai.

11.28.en: "Like rivers rushing into the ocean, these heroes are flowing into your blazing mouths."
11.28.hi: "Jaise nadiyaan samundar mein bhaagti hain, ye veer aapke jalte munh mein beh rahe hain."

11.29.en: "Like moths flying into a flame, they're rushing to their end."
11.29.hi: "Jaise patange aag mein udte hain, waise ye apne ant ki taraf bhaag rahe hain."

11.30.en: "You're swallowing the worlds with your flaming mouths. Your rays are burning up the universe."
11.30.hi: "Aap apne jalte munh se duniya nigal rahe ho. Aapki kiranein brahmaand ko jala rahi hain."

11.31.en: "Who are you in this terrifying form? Please be kind. I want to understand you."
11.31.hi: "Is darawne roop mein aap kaun ho? Please daya karo. Main aapko samajhna chahta hoon."

11.32.en: Krishna: "I am Time, the destroyer of worlds. Even without you, these warriors won't survive."
11.32.hi: Krishna: "Main Kaal hoon, duniya ka naash karne wala. Tumhare bina bhi ye yoddha nahi bachenge."

11.33.en: "So rise and win. I've already decided the outcome. You're just the instrument."
11.33.hi: "Toh utho aur jeeto. Result maine pehle hi tay kar diya hai. Tum bas nimitt ho."

11.34.en: "Their fate is sealed. Don't be distressed. Fight, and you'll win."
11.34.hi: "Unka bhagya tay hai. Pareshaan mat ho. Lado, aur tum jeetoge."

11.35.en: Arjuna, trembling and emotional, bows again and again and speaks with folded hands.
11.35.hi: Arjun, kaanpte aur emotional, baar-baar jhukta hai aur haath jod ke bolta hai.

11.36.en: "No wonder the world celebrates you. Negativity runs away, and the wise bow to you."
11.36.hi: "Isliye duniya aapka jashn manati hai. Negativity bhaagti hai, aur gyaani aapko pranaam karte hain."

11.37.en: "Why wouldn't they bow? You're the creator of even the creator. Infinite, Lord of gods."
11.37.hi: "Woh kyun na jhukein? Aap toh rachnakar ke bhi rachnakar ho. Anant, devon ke dev."

11.38.en: "You're the first God, the ancient one, the resting place of the universe, the knower and the known."
11.38.hi: "Aap pehle Bhagwan ho, sabse purane, brahmaand ka vishraam, jaanne wale aur jaanne layak bhi."

11.39.en: "You're wind, fire, water, the moon, the creator. A thousand salutes to you, again and again."
11.39.hi: "Aap hawa, aag, paani, chaand, rachnakar ho. Aapko hazaar baar pranaam, baar baar."

11.40.en: "Salutes from the front, from behind, from every side. You're everything, infinite in power."
11.40.hi: "Aage se, peeche se, har taraf se pranaam. Aap sab kuch ho, anant shakti wale."

11.41.en: "I called you 'buddy' and 'Krishna' casually, not knowing who you really are..."
11.41.hi: "Maine aapko casually 'yaar' aur 'Krishna' bulaya, ye jaane bina ki aap asli mein kaun ho..."

11.42.en: "...and joked around with you while eating and hanging out. Please forgive me." Best friend realising his friend is God.
11.42.hi: "...aur khaate-peete, ghoomte hue mazaak kiya. Please maaf karo." Best friend ko pata chala dost Bhagwan hai.

11.43.en: "You're the father of the world, the greatest teacher. No one equals you, let alone surpasses you."
11.43.hi: "Aap duniya ke pita ho, sabse bade guru. Koi aapke barabar nahi, aage toh door ki baat."

11.44.en: "I bow down completely. Forgive me like a father forgives a son, a friend a friend."
11.44.hi: "Main poori tarah jhukta hoon. Maaf karo jaise pita bete ko, dost dost ko karta hai."

11.45.en: "I'm thrilled but also scared. Please show me your familiar form again."
11.45.hi: "Main khush bhi hoon aur darr bhi raha hoon. Please apna jaana-pehchana roop phir dikhao."

11.46.en: "I want to see you with your crown, mace and discus, in your four-armed form."
11.46.hi: "Main aapko mukut, gada aur chakra ke saath, chaturbhuj roop mein dekhna chahta hoon."

11.47.en: Krishna: "Out of love I showed you this form. No one but you has ever seen it."
11.47.hi: Krishna: "Pyaar se maine tumhe ye roop dikhaya. Tumhare siva kisi ne ise nahi dekha."

11.48.en: "Not scriptures, rituals, charity or hard discipline can show this form. Only grace."
11.48.hi: "Na granth, na rituals, na daan, na tapasya ye roop dikha sakte hain. Sirf kripa."

11.49.en: "Don't be scared or confused. Relax, and look at my familiar form again."
11.49.hi: "Daro mat, confuse mat ho. Relax karo, aur mera jaana-pehchana roop phir dekho."

11.50.en: Krishna returns to his gentle human form and comforts the shaken Arjuna.
11.50.hi: Krishna apne saumya insaani roop mein lautte hain aur hile hue Arjun ko sambhalte hain.

11.51.en: Arjuna: "Seeing your human form again, I feel calm and like myself."
11.51.hi: Arjun: "Aapka insaani roop phir dekh ke main shaant hoon aur normal feel kar raha hoon."

11.52.en: "Even the gods long to see the form you just saw. It's incredibly rare."
11.52.hi: "Jo roop tumne dekha, use dekhne ko devta bhi tarasate hain. Bahut rare hai."

11.53.en: "Not through study, discipline, charity or rituals can anyone see me like that."
11.53.hi: "Padhai, tapasya, daan ya rituals se koi mujhe aise nahi dekh sakta."

11.54.en: "Only through pure, single-minded love can someone truly know, see and become one with me."
11.54.hi: "Sirf shuddh, ek-man pyaar se koi mujhe sach mein jaan, dekh aur mujhse ek ho sakta hai."

11.55.en: Work for me, make me your goal, love me, drop attachments and hate no one. That's how you reach me.
11.55.hi: Mere liye kaam karo, mujhe goal banao, pyaar karo, attachment chhodo, kisi se nafrat mat karo. Aise mujh tak pahunchoge.
